description:
Welcome to the Great Lakes of the USA!
Explore stunning destinations such as St. Cloud, Niagara Falls, Chicago, Cleveland, Milkwaukee, and many more!
Along your journey, you'll encounter fascinating trivia about the iconic locations, play fun mini-games, and see the beauty of the locations surrounding the Great Lakes.

- Behold the sights of the Great Lakes, all done in a Hidden Object style.
- Play over 30 fun minigames, all connected to the Great Lakes area!
- Pick up fun facts about the region!
- Collector's Edition contains 12 more chapters and 6 exclusive Hidden Object scenes!
name: Finding America: The Great Lakes Collector's Edition
intro: Explore the beautiful areas surrounding the Great Lakes of America!
